items.description:
According to the Leupe catalogue (NA), the original title reads: Plan van de Vesting Gale.
Halfway down the left-hand side: No. 6 in a different handwriting.
Notes on reverse: No. 6 Gale / 585 [stamped in bold on a small label].

Key: 1-32

Title in the Leupe catalogue (National Archives): Plan van Gale.
Bears the stamp: Depot des Cart. Pl. et Journ. de la Marine.

Notes on reverse: No. 12 [inscribed on a small label] / Gale. Plan van Johannes 1784. / 578 [printed in bold on a small label].
